maya: preflight finished for the summarizer run and the quality gate FAILED. ROUGE-1 -3.8% vs baseline, factuality-score down ~9%, 5/40 samples flagged for hallucination. canary should be held. change window closes in ~45m — need product + ops call on pin vs split vs rollback.

deploybot: preflight-check -> FAILED
  - suite: summarizer-compact-v4-prompts
  - diffs: rouge-1 -3.8%, factuality -9%, human-flag 5/40
  - suggested: pin back to v3.9.2 / phased rollback / 10-20% traffic split for quick mitigation / run bisect on v4.0.0
  - details: https://releases.redwood.ai/preflight/4390012345/results

trent: is the regression concentrated on multi-doc merges or on short summaries? any tokenizer drift?

naya: mostly multi-doc merging and list-to-paragraph condensation. also a couple context-window boundary cases. not purely tokenizer but anchoring looks worse.

kevin: ops can perform a regional route-split quickly. suggestion: US-east: 20% to v4.0.0, 80% to v3.9.2; EU: pin to v3.9.2 100% until we triage. need product sign-off to proceed. no downtime; session affinity preserved.

esme: product: if billable output is wrong we should minimize exposure. i'm leaning to full rollback globally to v3.9.2 while infra+ml bisect. can't risk customer-facing hallucinations.

ops-bot: FYI change-window policy: rollbacks during change window require product OK within 30m or escalation to oncall manager.

maya: @esme please confirm. if we do rollback, ops will pin and run a smoke sweep. if partial, we need to coordinate routes + feature flags.

esme: confirm rollback. proceed with pin to v3.9.2. create release note blurb and customer comms draft.

maya: executing: /deploybot pin summarizer v3.9.2 --reason "preflight factuality regression"

deploybot: acknowledged. job queued. id=rb-20240322-4390012345. status: running. logs: https://releases.redwood.ai/jobs/rb-20240322-4390012345/logs

trent: copied the 5 failing samples into eval-bisect/4390012345 for triage: https://evals.redwood.ai/buckets/4390012345/failures

kevin: once the pin completes i'll run the smoke-run across top_500 routes and validate latency and cost delta. expecting ~10-12m to finish validation.

esme: i've drafted the release note: "hotfix: revert summarizer to v3.9.2 after preflight detected factuality regression in v4.0.0. investigating root cause; follow-up ticket TKT-10202 opened." link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/TKT-10202

maya: opening follow-up bisect/bug tickets and assigning ML: https://tickets.redwood.ai/ML-4390. also adding the failing prompt subset to the persistent alert suite.

deploybot: pin job rb-20240322-4390012345 completed. status: SUCCESS. model summarizer -> v3.9.2 pinned.

kevin: smoke-run passed top_500 routes. no latency or cost regression observed.

maya: OK thanks team. holding release. will update #incidents and close thread after postmortem ticket created. :white_check_mark:
